title: Magnetic Shift
generation_prompt: Produce one ORIGINAL 128-second stereo SYNTHWAVE instrumental for an all-ages one-or-two-key rhythm game at STRICT constant 118 BPM in 4/4. The complete groove starts at time zero: short clean kick on EVERY quarter beat, dry snare on beats two and four, crisp eighth-note hats, rounded bass, warm analog chord stabs and a separate short bright analog-key attack on EVERY quarter beat. Keep each layer clearly audible at stable level through all 128 seconds, especially the first 16 and last 16 seconds. No ambient intro, fade, drumless break, half-time section, quiet passage, tempo drift, filtered outro or silent final bars. Signature hook: two clipped notes rotate around each other, then a lower four-note descending reply with a small upward final ping. Short releases and clear spaces make the beat easy to chart. At 64 seconds keep exactly the same drum grid and volume, change bass roots and chord voicings, move the rotating notes one octave higher, and answer with a new syncopated four-note variation until the last beat. Warm playful retro-synth color without harsh distortion or a known melody. No vocals, speech, samples, or imitation of another song.
cover_prompt: Create an original SQUARE 1:1 duohertz cover for Magnetic Shift, an all-ages synthwave rhythm-game track. Original high-contrast editorial comic-print cut-paper style: near-black ink, warm ivory, electric cyan, coral red, sparse large halftone. Main object: ONE compact stylized analog TAPE-CASSETTE silhouette in warm ivory, with TWO large cyan reel circles connected by a single visible coral tape strip that angles sharply upward between them to imply a rhythmic shift. Put exactly one small yellow beat diamond in the central tape window. Keep the cassette entirely within the central 60% of the square so the two reels and angled connector remain recognizable inside a narrow 100px mobile crop; quiet dark lower fifth for local title overlay. Flat graphic, bold simple silhouette, different from vinyl records, radios, piano keys or city windows. No brands, labels, text, letters, numbers, people, scenery, photorealism, logo, watermark, strobe or copied game art.
og_prompt: Edit the supplied original Magnetic Shift square cover into a HORIZONTAL roughly 1.9:1 duohertz social card. Preserve ONE compact warm-ivory stylized tape-cassette, exactly TWO large cyan reel circles, one coral tape strip angled upward between them and one small yellow diamond in the center window. Recompose the full cassette on the RIGHT half with near-black comic-print ink and sparse halftone; leave quiet dark space on the LEFT. Add exactly two crisp fully readable English text lines at left: 'duohertz' all lowercase electric cyan and 'Magnetic Shift' larger warm ivory. Spell both exactly with no truncation. Purpose-build the wide composition; do not stretch the square. No other labels, text, numbers, people, scenery, brand logos, watermark or copied game art.
